bots.name: CRM database cleanup agent [Duplicate]
bots.prompt:
I need to develop some kind of agent that is going to clean up our database. For example, the agent would go into a contact, see the domain name of that contact, and then it would tag that contact with appropriate tags that are related to that contact, like their industry and their location. If, from the domain name, it would know the address of that business, it would put the address inside of the contact field.

Basically, there's database enrichment. It's what it's called. There's a whole lot of leads in our system, but we only have an email address and a name. So much can be done to enrich our database contacts with a lot more. Even taking past opportunities that we never closed on and enriching those opportunities is another thing that the agent can do.

Now that we have AI, we can do so much better in our database, but an agent has to be created specifically to do this and to monitor this because we're constantly adding new leads into the system. I don't want the sales guys to have to waste their time enriching the data. Instead, the data should be enriched as it's created.

Let's talk about this project. Put this under the sales agents.

(Raised by Alex Miranda, Aug 20, 2026.)

bots.name: Claude Automation to Create Trainings from my calls

This would be an agent. The agent is in the sales team, as part of the sales training department.

I set up Viktor in automation so that it analyzes my fireflies calls from the day, figures out which ones are discovery calls, strategy sessions, and blueprints, and then creates a rating on what that session was. It then wants to create a training program to send to the sales guys so they can learn from it. It would have the fireflies link, the lessons, and it would be sent to Mark. Mark could decide to have the sales guys watch it.

Now, in Claude, I built a skill that is the training skill that also analyzes calls, so I have it built in Claude. Viktor, I'm able to automate it, but I know it's costing me more. How do I set this up so Claude does this, and Claude is the one that messages Marc for each training potential?

(Raised by Alex Miranda, Aug 11–12, 2026.)

bots.name: Dashboard Interactivo EOS - Quarterly Sessions con Gerardo (Ignacio)
bots.prompt:
CONTEXTO / SOLICITUD DE IGNACIO

Ignacio pidio construir un dashboard interactivo que reemplace los spreadsheets y attachments sueltos que hoy se usan en las quarterly sessions con el coach Gerardo (proceso EOS). El objetivo es poder llevar toda la reunion navegando pestana tras pestana dentro de un solo dashboard, con informacion siempre actualizada, editable en vivo durante la reunion, y que le ahorre tiempo a cualquiera del leadership team que lo use.

Division de trabajo:
- Andre (con ayuda de Italo): construye el dashboard.
- Ignacio: alimenta los skills del C-EOS instalados en su Claude Code para que el dashboard se nutra con esa info.

MATERIAL DE ORIGEN PROPORCIONADO POR IGNACIO
1. Summary notes y transcript de la intro call sobre como se hacen las quarterly sessions con Gerardo.
2. Agenda completa de la quarterly session (detallada abajo).

ESTRUCTURA DE LA AGENDA / SECCIONES QUE EL DASHBOARD DEBE CUBRIR (una pestana por seccion, idealmente):

1. Check-in
- Formulario que cada miembro del leadership team completa antes de la sesion (hoy es un adjunto).

2. Review Prior Quarter Rocks (hoy es un spreadsheet que usa Gerardo como base de revision)
- Date: quarter que arranca
- Revenue del quarter revisado
- Profit del quarter revisado
- Measurable: MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) objetivo al cierre de ese quarter
- Company Rocks
- Individual Rocks
- Departmental Rocks (si aplica)
- Quarterly grading del leadership team

3. Revision breve del EOS Model (EOS Tools / V/TO - 7 Questions)
- Data: si se usan scorecards y si cada persona tiene sus measurables (KPIs)
- Process: procesos documentados por departamento
- Traction: si los rocks se estan cumpliendo/asignando y si los L10s se hacen correctamente
- Issues: principales issues del quarter
- People: People Analyzer (fuente: [REDACTED — confidential Asana project, access-restricted, not to be shared outside leadership])

4. Establish Next Quarter Rocks
- Date: quarter que arranca
- Revenue del quarter
- Profit deseado al cierre
- Measurable: MRR objetivo
- Company Rocks del proximo quarter
- Individual Rocks del proximo quarter
- Departmental Rocks del proximo quarter (si aplica)

5. Tackle Key Issues

6. Next Steps
- Actualizar todo y organizar el townhall con todo el equipo para revisar el quarter cerrado y lanzar los rocks del siguiente quarter

7. Conclude

REQUISITO CLAVE DE PRODUCTO
No es un reporte estatico: tiene que ser un dashboard interactivo, editable en vivo durante la reunion (no solo de lectura), navegable por pestanas/secciones, que sustituya por completo los spreadsheets y attachments actuales.

NOTA DE CONFIDENCIALIDAD
La seccion de People (People Analyzer) referencia un Asana project marcado como confidencial. No compartir ese contenido fuera del leadership team ni exponerlo sin control de acceso adecuado en el dashboard.

PROXIMOS PASOS
- Andre: definir arquitectura del dashboard (Layer 1 vs Layer 2/3) y estructura de pestanas segun la agenda de arriba.
- Andre + Italo: construir el dashboard.
- Ignacio: cargar/alimentar los skills del C-EOS en su Claude Code para conectar la data.
- Validar con Ignacio el manejo de la seccion confidencial (People Analyzer) antes de dar acceso al leadership team.
